title: Hook blocked harmless commands that only mentioned a protected path
what_happened: The first PreToolUse hook blocked 7 commands in its own build session — a grep, commit messages, heredocs — none of which wrote to a protected path.
root_cause: The shell-write check matched a protected path anywhere in the command plus any redirect, instead of judging what is actually written.

title: eval-guard missed deleted check(...) assertions
what_happened: Piloting on lls-kit: its tests are check("desc", cond) calls, so removing one passed eval-guard silently.
root_cause: Test definitions were hard-coded to def test_ / it( / @Test styles.

title: sdlc/cli.py exceeded a 12 KB input-size gate
what_happened: Vendored into lls-kit, the 12.2 KB cli.py failed lls-kit's input-size gate.
root_cause: No size budget on the package itself; the gate that caught it belonged to the consuming repository.

title: Spec template placeholder counted as acceptance criteria
what_happened: The comment <!-- AC-1, AC-2 ... --> in the spec template was parsed as real criteria, so an empty spec could be submitted.
root_cause: Section extraction did not strip HTML comments.

title: A finding reported from a sample was wrong on the full data
what_happened: Claimed PRs #20 and #24 were T3 only because of the test list; re-measuring all 25 PRs showed #20 also changed inputsize.py (a gate).
root_cause: The claim was generalised from a partial diff check instead of measured over every PR.

control.ref: CLAUDE.md::- Before reporting a pattern from data, re-measure it over the full set and cite the count. (L-005)

title: sdlc serve crashed with a traceback on a busy port
what_happened: Starting the web app on 8766 (already taken) printed an OSError traceback.
root_cause: serve() errors were not handled at the CLI boundary.

title: Korean site rendered as mojibake when served locally
what_happened: Served by http.server, every Korean character on the site was garbled in the first screenshot.
root_cause: The page relied on the artifact wrapper for <meta charset>; served directly it had none.

title: Agent and skill descriptions with ': ' were invalid YAML
what_happened: Frontmatter like description: Reviews a diff for security defects: authn/... fails a real YAML parser.
root_cause: Generated frontmatter values were not quoted.

title: Site logo shipped with no arcs
what_happened: A DOM check found 0 arc paths in the brand mark after the icon change.
root_cause: The patch script's regex expected stroke-width="7" but the generated SVG said "7.0".

title: Pipeline links carried two style attributes
what_happened: Adding a stage colour produced <a style=... style=...>; the browser dropped the second attribute.
root_cause: Attributes were added by string edit without merging an existing style.

title: Blocked-command patterns match text inside heredocs and messages
what_happened: Commits whose message mentioned the approve command, and a heredoc containing the CLI example, were blocked as if they ran it.
root_cause: blocked_commands regexes run on the raw command, including heredoc bodies and quoted strings; the pending patch fixes shell writes but not this.

title: 상세 담당자 chip이 모바일 화면 밖으로 넘쳤다
what_happened: W-0005 browser regression: 375px Korean detail document.scrollWidth exceeded viewport; owner text overflowed its grid cell.
root_cause: The inherited max-content metadata grid and nowrap chip did not allow a long owner identity to wrap.

title: HTTP 새 작업 생성의 owner 입력에 frontmatter 줄바꿈 주입이 가능했다
what_happened: POST /api/work passed owner directly into the intent template; newline input could inject status and approval keys.
root_cause: The API checked only nonempty values before substituting owner into quoted frontmatter.

title: 개요 카드를 링크로 바꾸며 닫는 태그를 잘못 유지했다
what_happened: The active-work tile opened with an anchor and closed with div, breaking the overview tiles grid.
root_cause: A text replacement changed the opening wrapper but missed its closing tag.

title: 여러 AC를 축약해 표기하면 trace가 각 기준을 인식하지 못한다
what_happened: The frontend test label W-0005:AC-2 AC-4 AC-5 exercised the behaviors but trace reported AC-5 missing; expanded each label to a full W-0005:AC-n tag.
root_cause: Human-readable shorthand was mistaken for the trace scanner required full tag format.
